protocol.study: 1IEP paired-seed search effort experiment; distinct from historical four runs
protocol.success_definition: symmetry-corrected heavy atom crystal RMSD <= 2.0 angstrom; no alignment or centering
protocol.primary_endpoint: top-scored saved pose success fraction, n=5 per exhaustiveness
protocol.secondary_endpoint: at least one saved pose success fraction; not all searched conformations
protocol.contact_definition: residue contact if any receptor/ligand heavy atom distance <= 4.0 angstrom; compare residue sets to crystal
protocol.analysis: Report all 15 runs, all saved poses, paired outcomes, Wilson 95% intervals (descriptive, n=5); no seed or threshold selection after results
protocol.timing_limit: Wall-clock timing includes contention from concurrent local work; not a hardware performance benchmark
protocol.generalization_limit: One prepared co-crystal system; seed success fractions do not establish cross-target accuracy
